entries.basis: Accepted year-scroll/independent-navigation and centered-month-choice receipts cover multi-month presentation, responsive month/year choices, keyboard navigation and focus restoration in all three desktop engines; current Material picker-radius six-case continuation passes both densities/themes with zero failures/skips. Current Calendar and DateRangeSelector source hashes match retained navigation proof. Two quiet probes exercise actual installed live-announcer output: leap-day keyboard selection emits a full weekday/month/day/year selected-date caption and completed range emits contextual full-date endpoints. SGUI preserves complete accessible date names and hides decorations. This establishes implementation support and meaningful emitted messages; actual spoken delivery remains the separate manual-AT gate.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-K-05 Reconcile original `K-05`: Support multi-month presentation, responsive container sizing, month/year navigation, keyboard navigation, focus return, and meaningful date announcements. Historical status: open.

limits: Announcement probes are jsdom/English actual live-region DOM evidence, not spoken AT or a new native-browser observation. Retained native scopes keep their original source/runtime limits. The broader manual platform/screen-reader review remains A-X-11 and is not waived; no audible test was run.
